## Context

We need a small embedded database for local-first storage.
title: ADR 0001: Use SQLite › Context

content:
### Alternatives Considered

- Postgres — too heavy for a single-user desktop app.
- MySQL — same concern, plus an extra service to run.
title: ADR 0001: Use SQLite › Context › Alternatives Considered
ADR 0001: Use SQLite › Decision

content:
## Consequences

Simpler ops, less horizontal scale.
title: ADR 0001: Use SQLite › Consequences
